sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO at LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents, highlighting how multi-agent systems are moving from experimental to production-ready. Shared insights on infrastructure requirements and the importance of reliable tool calling and memory management for scalable deployments.

sources.author: Swyx
sources.headline: Founder at Latent.Space | AI Engineer
sources.post_summary: Covered the current state of AI automation tooling, emphasizing the gap between hype and real developer workflows. Shared practical examples of how teams are integrating agentic workflows into existing CI/CD pipelines and the tooling challenges that remain.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Independent AI Researcher & Creator of Datasette
sources.post_summary: Explored the infrastructure challenges of running AI agents at scale, particularly around observability, cost management, and debugging. Provided concrete examples of monitoring agent behavior and the tooling gaps that still need to be addressed by the community.

sources.author: Kelvin Liew
sources.headline: Head of AI at Replit
sources.post_summary: Shared how Replit is building AI-native developer tools that leverage agents for code generation and debugging. Discussed the automation patterns that work well versus those that create more friction than they remove in real developer environments.

sources.author: Elena Voss
sources.headline: Head of GTM Engineering @ Ramp
sources.post_summary: Discussed how GTM engineering teams are shifting from manual outbound to building internal tooling that automates lead enrichment, sequencing, and qualification. Shared a case study where their team reduced SDR workload by 40% by integrating custom data pipelines with CRM triggers.

sources.author: Marcus Hale
sources.headline: VP Revenue Operations @ Notion
sources.post_summary: Explained the evolution of revenue operations from reporting dashboards to proactive systems that predict pipeline health. Highlighted the importance of aligning sales, marketing, and CS data models to create a single source of truth for forecasting.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: Founder @ Outbound OS
sources.post_summary: Shared a framework for building outbound automation stacks that combine intent data, multi-channel sequencing, and AI-personalized messaging. Emphasized measuring reply quality over volume and shared metrics from teams running 5k+ personalized sequences monthly.

sources.author: David Kline
sources.headline: Director of Content Strategy @ Webflow
sources.post_summary: Outlined how content strategy should be treated as a revenue function, not just brand awareness. Detailed a system where content topics are prioritized based on pipeline influence data pulled from closed-won deals and sales call recordings.

sources.author: Sofia Patel
sources.headline: GTM Engineer @ Deel
sources.post_summary: Walked through building a custom lead scoring model using both firmographic data and behavioral signals from product usage. Showed how this model feeds directly into automated outbound sequences, improving conversion rates by 3x.

sources.author: Danny Postma
sources.headline: Founder @ Typedream | No-code tools for creators
sources.post_summary: Shared his journey building and shipping a new AI feature for Typedream in under a week as a solo founder. Highlighted the importance of talking to users daily and iterating fast based on feedback instead of overbuilding.

sources.author: Pieter Levels
sources.headline: Founder @ Nomad List, Remote OK, Hoodmaps
sources.post_summary: Posted about shipping a new micro-SaaS in 4 days while traveling. Broke down the tech stack, user acquisition channels, and how he validates ideas quickly without a team.

sources.author: Sara Mauskopf
sources.headline: Founder & CEO @ Winnie | Ex-Google, Ex-YouTube
sources.post_summary: Discussed her transition from big tech to founding a startup and the mindset shifts required. Shared lessons on building in public, fundraising, and staying authentic on LinkedIn.

sources.author: Arvid Kahl
sources.headline: Author of Zero to Sold | Indie Founder
sources.post_summary: Wrote about pivoting from corporate engineering to bootstrapped SaaS. Detailed the first 90 days of building in public, including how he gained his first 100 paying users through consistent updates.

sources.author: Vic Vijayakumar
sources.headline: Solo Founder @ Rowy | Previously Staff Engineer @ Google
sources.post_summary: Shared his experience leaving Google to build an open-source Firebase alternative solo. Posted weekly updates on product development, community growth, and technical challenges overcome.
